outgoing.section: The X client-server model and network transparency
outgoing.excerpt: A client and server can even communicate securely over the Internet by tunneling the connection over an encrypted network session.

outgoing.name: Latin alphabet
outgoing.excerpt: X derives its name as a successor to a pre-1983 window system called W (the letter X directly following W in the Latin alphabet).
